audit_metadata.phase: PHASE 8B.6A: MODEL TRAINING STRATEGY & ARCHITECTURE READINESS AUDIT

environment_audit.engine_architecture: Pure NumPy Numerical Engine (Architected for Python 3.14 native Windows binary compatibility)

config_py.findings: Central paths hardcoded to data/processed. Requires dedicated Phase 8B.6B script or configurable CLI flags to prevent overwriting historical Stage 6/7 baseline.

train_py.findings: Pure NumPy implementation of StandardScalerNumPy, SoftmaxRegressionNumPy, and NearestCentroidNumPy. StandardScaler correctly fit strictly on X_train. Supports L2 regularization and mini-batch SGD.

evaluate_py.findings: Computes confusion matrix, macro/weighted precision, recall, F1, and weak class tracking in pure NumPy. Fully compatible with 49 classes.

export_model_to_frontend_py.findings: Exports W (758, 49), b (49), scaler_mean (758), scaler_scale (758), classes (49), and labels (49) to frontend/public/models/sign_classifier.json. Verified 100% numerical parity.

sign_classifier_ts.findings: TypeScript inference engine at frontend/src/utils/signClassifier.ts implements 4-stage rejection pipeline: Gate 1 (Presence >= 0.20), Gate 2 (Motion >= 0.05), Gate 3 (Confidence >= 0.45), Gate 4 (Temporal Debouncer >= 2 frames). Matrix-vector dot product runs in < 0.05 ms.

candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: Moderate-Low (L2 weight decay penalizes large weights in p > n regime)
candidate_architectures.training_complexity: Low (< 5s runtime in pure NumPy via mini-batch SGD / L-BFGS)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: 100% Drop-in Compatible (exact match with existing signClassifier.ts)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Strongly Recommended (Historical benchmark: 74.3% with leakage; establishes new un-leaked gold standard)

candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: Zero (Zero hyperparameters, rigid spherical class prototype assumption)
candidate_architectures.training_complexity: Negligible (< 10ms runtime, single-pass class-wise vector mean)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: Fully Compatible (requires simple Euclidean distance comparison in TypeScript)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Mandatory Benchmark (Tests whether simple class centroids match or exceed linear hyperplanes in high dims)

candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: Zero (Invariant to feature magnitude, focuses purely on geometric angle)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: Fully Compatible (computes dot product of unit-normalized vector with 49 unit centroids)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Highly Recommended (Cosine distance often outperforms Euclidean distance in 758-dim feature spaces)

candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: Low-Moderate (Max-margin optimization resists overfitting in p > n regime via margin slack control)
candidate_architectures.training_complexity: Low (< 10s runtime in pure NumPy via subgradient descent or Pegasos)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: 100% Drop-in Compatible (decision function is identical: W^T * z + b; calibrated via temperature softmax)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Strongly Recommended (Structural risk minimization theoretically superior to cross-entropy in sparse/high-dim data)

candidate_architectures.model_name: Small Multi-Layer Perceptron (1 Hidden Layer, 128 units)
candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: High (103k parameters vs 631 samples; requires strong dropout + weight decay + early stopping on val loss)
candidate_architectures.training_complexity: Moderate (~30-60s in pure NumPy with Adam optimizer and mini-batches)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: Feasible (requires updating TypeScript inference to execute one hidden layer matrix multiply + ReLU, ~20 lines TS)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Exploratory Candidate (Evaluate if non-linear boundary capture offsets parameter overfitting risk)

candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: Moderate (k=1 memorizes training set; k=5 subject to dimensional sparsity)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: Sub-optimal for Edge (requires shipping 1.9MB training dataset to browser; 631 dot products per video frame)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Reference Benchmark Only (Useful for theoretical upper bound on local neighborhood similarity; not for production)

candidate_architectures.param_breakdown: N_sv support vectors x 758 floats + dual coefficients (approx 300-500 SVs)
candidate_architectures.overfitting_risk: High in small samples without exhaustive gamma cross-validation
candidate_architectures.training_complexity: High in pure NumPy (requires quadratic programming / SMO solver implementation)
candidate_architectures.frontend_compatibility: Incompatible / High Latency (evaluating non-linear exponential kernel across hundreds of SVs in JavaScript loop)
candidate_architectures.recommendation: Not Recommended for Deployment (High client computational overhead; unsuited for 30fps real-time inference)

experimental_protocol.scaling_protocol: StandardScaler fit STRICTLY on train.npz (N=631). Scaler parameters (mean_, scale_) frozen and applied to transform val.npz and test.npz without re-fitting.
experimental_protocol.tuning_protocol: All hyperparameter selection and candidate model checkpoint selection performed EXCLUSIVELY against val.npz (N=142). Primary metric: Validation Macro F1. Secondary metric: Validation Accuracy.
experimental_protocol.test_holdout_protocol: test.npz (N=142) remains 100% FROZEN and UNTOUCHED throughout model exploration and tuning. Evaluated ONCE on winning models in Phase 8B.6B.

statistical_caveats.samples_per_class_test: 44 classes with 3 samples, 5 classes with 2 samples
statistical_caveats.quantization_effect: A single classification error on a 3-sample class causes a 33.3% swing in recall. On a 2-sample class, a 50.0% swing.
statistical_caveats.global_confidence_interval: At 75% accuracy, 95% Wilson score interval is [67.3%, 81.3%] (SE = 3.63%). Small differences between models within 3% are not statistically significant.

experimental_protocol.generalization_scope: Rigorously cross-session and take-independent (0 session burst overlap, 0 within-class possible-signer overlap). NOT certified subject-independent (signer unknown for 62.6% of raw dataset).
